repo.description:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server provides optional monitoring and profiling endpoints. Some debug responses include the server command-line arguments.

### Problem Description

Redaction of command-line credentials did not cover route and cluster URL arguments. When those arguments contained credentials, monitoring or profiling responses could disclose them to anyone able to access the relevant endpoints. The issue requires credentials in command-line URLs and an accessible monitoring or profiling listener.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.11.17, v2.12.8, v2.14.0 and v2.15.0. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Move route and cluster URLs containing credentials from command-line arguments into the server configuration file. Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-5qvj-hvwx-q9qf>
 * Credit: Koda Reef (@kodareef5)
repo.summary: Route and cluster URL credentials can be exposed by debug endpoints
